cats.name: Sir Whiskerbottom the Third
cats.backstory: Sir Whiskerbottom III was once the esteemed feline of an eccentric scholar who lived in a towering library. Over the years, he developed a taste for fine literature (mostly sleeping on open books) and a talent for finding the coziest sunspots.

cats.name: Professor Puddingpaws
cats.backstory: Graduating top of his class in Laziness and Lounging, Professor Puddingpaws spends his days peering thoughtfully out of windows, offering silent critiques to every pigeon that dares enter his sightline. He dreams of one day catching the Red Dot.

cats.name: Captain Marmalade
cats.backstory: Born under a crooked coffee table, Captain Marmalade has always had a thirst for adventure. From scaling laundry mountains to disappearing into mysterious closets, he carries a single mission: find all lost socks and claim them as trophies.

cats.name: Madam Fluffernoodle
cats.backstory: A retired champion of the Whisker Grooming Circuit, Madam Fluffernoodle now devotes her days to seeking out the softest, warmest blankets. If your lap doesn't meet her standards, she will politely reposition herself elsewhere without hesitation.

cats.name: Detective Tater Tot
cats.backstory: Whenever a thud, creak, or clatter occurs, Detective Tater Tot is hot on the case. With his trusty magnifying stare and lightning-fast paw taps, he unravels household mysteries — often revealing them to be...absolutely nothing. Still, he takes no chances.
